findings.title: Transformed monitor config copy is discarded in occurrence context
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor.config into `config` and replaces `config["schedule_type"]` with the human-readable display value, but the returned context uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of `config`. The transformed copy is therefore discarded and incident occurrences contain the raw schedule_type value rather than the intended display value.
